items.title: Phil Woods — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: my mother’s name was Clara, Clara, Clara Mary Markley Woods

ctx.x: Hey Phil, just for the record, we didn’t get the name of your parents and your brother, just for the record.
Oh yes, my mother’s name was Clara, Clara, Clara Mary Markley Woods and my father was Stanley Joseph and my brother was Stanley Joseph, Jr. and uh my namesake uncle was Phil Markley,
who was a representative up in Boston. uh He was a politician, good man. He was he and my dad had a business together, and were very close.
